summary: Comprehensive testing of new Parts Finder feature (public /parts-finder page, POST /api/parts-finder/search, GET /api/parts-finder/config, admin GET/PUT /api/admin/parts-finder/settings, admin UI sub-tab). All 7 backend pytest cases pass; full E2E UI flow (public search + admin settings persistence) works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes _id and never returns api_key/base_url via the public /parts-finder/config endpoint (security verified by test).
AI rank uses gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations and gracefully falls back to plain catalog matches on failure (mode='basic'). Good defensive handling.
FinderQuery uses a Pydantic model with sensible string defaults; 400 returned when ALL fields empty — matches UX expectation.
Minor: PartsFinderSettings.js does a single GET on mount without showing a loading state (returns null until cfg loads). Not a bug, but a tiny UX polish could add a skeleton.
test_credentials: admin@avarus.ru/admin (admin), user@demo.com/demo123 (client, not needed — page is public)
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_UI_Laximo settings via admin PUT; cleaned up TEST_KEY_12345 from backend test class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_parts_finder.py covers public config (no api_key leak), search 400 on empty, search 200 with query/brand returning ranked AI results, admin GET/PUT settings with persistence + public-config reflection. UI was verified at https://order-merge-fulfill.preview.emergentagent.com/parts-finder: empty submit shows finder-error 'Заполните хотя бы одно поле'; with query='фильтр топливный'+brand='MAN' the AI mode returned 3 cards with confidence badges (68%, 44%, 40%) — clicking a card navigates to /product/{id}. Admin Настройки → Подбор запчастей sub-tab shows the parts-finder-settings panel, save persists across reload (toast 'Настройки подбора сохранены' confirmed). One playwright nit: clicking the radix Switch via force=True did not always flip aria-checked — likely a test interaction artifact (visual state was correct in screenshot); backend PUT path is exercised by pytest with catalog_enabled=true and verified.
